verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists "Custom ring orders" and the homepage claims it can "Route incoming calls to the right person instantly." Missed calls produce voicemail transcripts, which implies unanswered calls go to voicemail. All of this comes from thin marketing bullets rather than routing documentation. missing for 10: explicit simultaneous-ring support for groups, documented fallback routing of unanswered calls to another number, in-depth routing docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can ring a group in order or simultaneously, and route unanswered calls to voicemail or another number

citations.quote: Custom ring orders ... Call transfers ... Phone menus
